---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Writing docs

- Write so an 8th-grade student in India can follow: short sentences, everyday words, one idea per sentence.
- Explain a technical word in a few simple words the first time you use it, for example "an index (a sorted list that makes searching fast)".
- Make the words simple, never the facts. Keep exact names, numbers, commands and file paths.
- Say plainly what is done and what is not done. Make no claim without a recorded check (hard rule 3).
- Update the existing doc instead of making a new file for each change (hard rule 13). The plan and status live in `docs/project/roadmap.md`.
- Use relative links, and check that they work.
